---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR),
    total_team_games = sum(G),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = total_home_runs)) +
  geom_line()
```
